C1047.title: The Hidden Cost of BYOD: How Personal Devices Threaten Enterprise Security
C1047.summary: CyberUnit analysis reveals that the hidden costs of BYOD manifest in customer data breaches, operational disruptions, regulatory fines, and direct financial losses. Citing the LastPass incident as an example, the article shows that the convenience of BYOD comes with real security risks, where an initial breach can lead to financial damage persisting for years.
